raw_segments.text: Macduff, fit to govern? No, not to live. O nation miserable, with an untitled, tyrant
bloody, sceptered, when shalt thou see thy wholesome days again, since that the truest
issue of thy throne by his own interdiction stands accused, and does blaspheme his breed.
Thy royal father was a most sainted king. The queen that bore thee, oftener upon her
knees than on her feet, died every day she lived. Fare thee well.
These evils thou repeatst thee upon thyself have banished me from Scotland.
O my breast, thy hope ends here.
